Name: evade
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §1-2: one Evade (Space) replaces Dash and Dodge, about 2 m, brief i-frames, about 0.8 s cooldown, cancels any attack at any frame, combo state survives, Evade -> Light lunge; steer_per_s: M1.3 owner feedback (C12, design/reviews/user-comments-2026-11-24.md) - steerable like NieR: Automata, movement input pivots the evade within it (limited turn rate; distance, i-frames and cooldown unchanged)

Name: perfect_evade
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §1: a well-timed evade (enemy hit imminent) gives a short slow-mo and a counter window. NieR: Automata reference (web, unverified frame data): perfect evade = dodge just before the hit; attack right after it counters

Name: attack_steer
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §3: reduced, slow steering during an attack from its first frame (25-35% of walk speed)

Name: cornered
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §8: an outnumbered or surrounded enemy hisses and lashes out at the nearest or weakest attacker; token limits do not apply to it; values prototype

Name: leader_ai
_src: M1.3 owner feedback (C12, design/reviews/user-comments-2026-11-24.md): Captains and Bosses use their basic strings between skills on a steady cadence (gap after recovery), retaliate against an attacker that lands 3 hits in 2 s, lash out faster when 2+ opponents are within 3 m, and always hold an attack token; values prototype

Name: final_ko
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §8: Final KO cinematic (zoom-in, frame freeze over an impact background, then ~1.5 s slow motion), within flash limits

Name: knockdown_s
_src: M1.2 spec (design/reviews/owner-feedback/combat-m1.2-spec.md) §9: the shockwave knocks a cat down unless it evades (same as posse_splat_s)

Name: knockdown_invuln
_src: M1.3 prototype: a cat knocked down by the shockwave is invulnerable while it is down (no hits on a downed cat), so a ring followed by swings cannot chain a wipe

Name: stagger_slow

Name: special
